step1.label: Step 1 — Authorize with Zoho
step1.description: Click the button below. You'll be redirected to Zoho to grant access, then automatically returned here with your new refresh token.

step2.label: Or paste authorization code manually
step2.description: If the redirect was intercepted (e.g. from a self-client JSON file), paste the code value here. Codes expire in 60 seconds — paste immediately after generating.

status.copyIdle: ↑ Click to copy · Permanent token — do not share
status.warning: ⚠ Close this tab after saving. Do not share the refresh token.

items.text: Copy the refresh token above (click it)
Go to Settings → Secrets in the builder
Update ZOHO_REFRESH_TOKEN with the copied value
Re-publish — email delivery will be live immediately
